concepts.title: Class marks and intervals
concepts.explanation: The class mark is the midpoint of a class interval, (lower + upper)/2. In grouped-mean calculations this midpoint represents the values in that class.

example.problem: A class has mark 25 and width 10. Find its lower limit.

concepts.commonMistake: The class width is upper minus lower; it is not the class mark.
checklist: Average them for the class mark.

concepts.title: Cumulative frequencies
concepts.explanation: A cumulative frequency adds all frequencies up to and including a class. Subtract successive cumulative totals to recover a class frequency.

example.problem: Cumulative frequency before a class is 6 and through that class is 16. Find its frequency.

concepts.commonMistake: A cumulative total includes earlier classes, not only the current one.
checklist: Subtract successive totals to recover a frequency.
Check the last total equals N.

concepts.title: Grouped mean
concepts.explanation: The estimated grouped mean is Σfᵢxᵢ/Σfᵢ, where xᵢ are class marks. Frequencies supply the weights.

example.problem: Class marks are 2, 6, 10, with frequencies 1, 2, 3. Find the grouped mean.

concepts.commonMistake: An unweighted average of class marks is wrong when frequencies differ.
checklist: Multiply each midpoint by its frequency.

concepts.title: Grouped median
concepts.explanation: Find the median class using N/2 and cumulative frequencies. The estimated median is l + [(N/2 − cf)/f]h, where cf is the cumulative frequency before that class.

example.problem: Continuous classes [20,30), [30,40), [40,50) have frequencies 4, 12, 4. Find the grouped median.
steps: N = 20; the middle class contains N/2 = 10.

concepts.commonMistake: Use cf before the median class, not the cumulative total including it.
checklist: Identify l, cf, f and h.

concepts.title: Grouped mode
concepts.explanation: For equal-width classes, the modal class has the greatest frequency. The estimated mode is l + [(f₁−f₀)/(2f₁−f₀−f₂)]h.

example.problem: A modal class has l = 20, h = 10, f₀ = 4, f₁ = 10, f₂ = 6. Find the grouped mode.

concepts.commonMistake: f₀ and f₂ are neighbouring class frequencies, not cumulative frequencies.
checklist: Use the mode formula with the class width.
